faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) for a project-based research position in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Research Associate-II under advertisement number P.Rect./R&D/2026/196, offering a great research opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Associate-II position under this specific recruitment drive at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD degree in Chemistry, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or Physics along with relevant modeling knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary provided for the Research Associate-II position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 61000 per month plus HRA as per the established norms of the institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving online applications for the IIT Kanpur Research Associate-II recruitment is 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through the online mode using the provided Google Form link or by scanning the QR code.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Kanpur for this research associate recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Kanpur Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification details and application link directly from the Important Links section provided in this article.
